2608.14367.title: Mind the Long Tail: Understanding the Difficulty of Delay Detection in Business Processes
2608.14367.paper_summary: The early detection of delayed cases in business processes is a critical capability for organizations. Predictive process monitoring (PPM) supports this task by using historical event logs to predict the remaining time of ongoing cases, enabling timely interventions to avoid missed deadlines and service level violations. Although remaining time prediction has advanced considerably through sophisticated deep learning architectures, little is known about the intrinsic difficulty of delay detection itself. Since performance is typically assessed using aggregate metrics, prior work provides limited insight into how models perform across the target distribution, especially on the operationally most critical cases with large delays. In this paper, we address this gap by analyzing the difficulty of delay detection. Across 14 event logs, we show that remaining times are typically strongly right-skewed, with only a small fraction of cases exhibiting large delays. Existing models capture the mode of this distribution well but perform poorly on high-delay cases. We further uncover pronounced heteroscedasticity, showing that predictive uncertainty increases with delay magnitude. Based on these findings, we evaluate approaches to mitigate the imbalance problem, but find only limited benefits, suggesting that the key underlying problem may not be imbalance but higher uncertainty associated with delayed cases. We show that this correlation can be exploited to substantially improve the identification of delayed cases. Overall, our work provides new insights into the sources of difficulty in delay detection and identifies uncertainty-aware modeling as a promising direction for future PPM research.
2608.14367.paper_summary_zh: 早期檢測商業流程中的延遲案例對於組織來說是一項關鍵能力。預測流程監控（PPM）通過使用歷史事件日誌來預測正在進行的案例的剩餘時間，支持這一任務，使得能夠及時干預以避免錯過截止日期和服務水平違規。儘管剩餘時間預測在複雜的深度學習架構中已經有了相當大的進展，但對於延遲檢測本身的內在難度卻知之甚少。由於性能通常使用聚合指標來評估，因此先前的研究對於模型在目標分佈中的表現提供的見解有限，特別是在延遲較大的運營上最關鍵的案例中。在本文中，我們通過分析延遲檢測的難度來填補這一空白。在14個事件日誌中，我們顯示剩餘時間通常呈現出強烈的右偏分佈，只有一小部分案例表現出較大的延遲。現有模型很好地捕捉了這一分佈的眾數，但在高延遲案例上的表現不佳。我們進一步發現顯著的異方差性，顯示預測不確定性隨著延遲幅度的增加而增加。基於這些發現，我們評估了減輕不平衡問題的方法，但僅發現有限的好處，這表明根本的關鍵問題可能不是不平衡，而是與延遲案例相關的更高不確定性。我們展示了這種相關性可以被利用來顯著改善延遲案例的識別。總的來說，我們的工作提供了對延遲檢測難度來源的新見解，並確定了以不確定性為中心的建模作為未來PPM研究的一個有前景的方向。
